"נַ נַ ְח נַ ְחָמ נַ ְח ָמן מאומן.."]…
segments.en:
...[This brings the redemption closer]

Certainly, every utterance of Rabbainu, of blessed memory, that enters some J.., some..

[Jew]

Jew, then this is already his redemption, his rectification…

...Not yet, {..}…

...And we will believe in the Torah and the mitzvos, and we will be like children with Hashem Yisborach

That is it, that is the ultimate purpose, that is life…

...Life, life of a kind of animal

There are animals that walk on four legs

And there are animals that walk on two legs

In the world, animals walk around on two legs and also speak...

...And to believe that Hashem Yisborach hears every prayer

And even a good desire that we have, Hashem Yisborach knows everything, and helps us and wants to help us

Only the main thing is that we are far from faith and from truth

We are "the Jewish people"

We received the Torah and we are

"The people of the Torah"

"The people of Hashem"

Yes

And all our vitality is in the Torah and the mitzvos; this is all the vitality…

...[…..]

[…..]

Ho..

[Saba and the friends sing:

"Na Na-ch Nachma Nachman MeUman.."]…
